claude.performance_metric: Sold 72 MW (Thailand + South Africa) at ~$16M combined loss on disposition ($8M net); Malaysia 19 MW sale agreed but unclosed; India/China/Brazil retained
claude.rationale: The slice documents an orderly post-close trajectory: routine divestitures of non-core solar assets in Thailand and South Africa (held-for-sale since 2018) at modest losses, a pending Malaysia sale, and continued operation of India, China, and Brazil assets. No lines describe disruption at the product/process interface — the acquired renewable assets continued to operate and be reported normally — so p4_pathway is 0. No lines describe operations fracturing against people/management/culture (no integration failures, workforce conflict beyond routine collective-agreement disclosures, or organizational breakdown), so p5_pathway is 0. The declining use of the "TerraForm Global" naming label in FY2021 is a labeling/reporting change, not documented archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility.

gemini.performance_metric: sold 72 MW of non-core solar assets in South Africa and Thailand at a combined $16 million loss on disposition
gemini.rationale: The evidence slice documents the sale of 72 MW of non-core solar assets in Thailand and South Africa, which had been held for sale since 2018. There is no documented evidence of product/process incoherence (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) driving these divestitures or affecting the retained assets in Brazil, India, and China.

openai.performance_metric: 72 MW sold at a combined $16 million loss on disposition
openai.rationale: The realized record documents sales of 72 MW of non-core South Africa and Thailand solar assets and a pending sale of the 19 MW Malaysia portfolio, but it does not attribute these actions to product/process incoherence. India, China, and Brazil operations continued to be reported, and no documented operational breakdown involving employees, management, or culture establishes a process/organization fracture.
